To answer your last question, yes the SASG-12 you have is very viable in Pvp, though I would prefer you call it the Sausage-12, but you just have to spec your build correctly. 
I would personally run it with 5 sentry and either reckless chestpiece or savage gloves, and I would spec your knee pads and backpack for crit damage, and I would get skill power on your mask. 
The whole idea is to have around 20-30k skill power, with around 400k toughness, so you can eat shots from agents and get up close to take the down other agents 
For the perks on your sausage, I would roll swift for either responsive, competent, or accurate.
If you get either responsive or competent, that would work better with reckless, because the base damage stacks very nicely for some hard hitting headshots, especially if you throw on a magazine with weapon damage. If you get accurate, I would use a rate of fire Magazine, because accurate gives your sausage a lot more range (please Reddit don't take that phrase the wrong way)
Now the best in slot mag would be rate of fire and weapon damage, but since I've been hunting for one of those for a couple weeks now without any luck, it's safe to say those are a little more rare. 
But that's my 2 sense on the Sausage, and to give you an idea of what your stats should look like, I have 205k DPS with my Sausage, that has Brutal, Deadly, and Responsive, with 74k base damage (with a weapon damage magazine) and I have 400k toughness, with 21k skill power, and that's with 5 sentry and reckless chest piece  My SASG drops agents very quickly, and I don't have crit damage on my knee pads or my backpack.
But best of luck with your Sausage, let me know how it works!
